scripts.postgres:check: docker compose -f postgres-for-development.yml ps --status running -q postgres | grep -q . || (echo 'Postgres is not running. Start it with: npm run postgres:up' && exit 1)
scripts.dev:server: npm run postgres:check && cd ./file-system-app-server && npm run dev
scripts.docker-compose: docker compose down; docker compose build --no-cache; docker compose up --force-recreate -d
